title: NEXUS command message (generic contract 1.0 and legacy-v1)
description: NEXUS to device, published on nexus/devices/<deviceId>/commands. Structural layer only. The capability-specific meaning of value (boolean for LED, FAN and BUZZER; integer 0..180 for SERVO; a channel/state object for RELAY) is layer 5 and needs a capability profile. This schema is deliberately not narrowed to the LED-only ESP32 firmware (see command.esp32-legacy.schema.json).
x-nexus-rules: freshness (layer 4): the command age is judged against the window of the selected profile with an injected reference time, never against an implicit clock

capability semantics (layer 5): SET_STATE with a boolean (LED, FAN, BUZZER), an integer 0..180 (SERVO) or an object with an integer channel and a boolean state (RELAY; channel membership needs the binding's channels)
